data.name: Akkor
data.detailed_description:
Akkor is a turn-based strategy game for two players. You and your opponent each control a star and a set of planets that move along orbits inside a 3D arena. You win by making one of your planets collide with the opponent’s star. Plan orbits, time your moves, use rotation and movement of your whole “galaxy” to set up the hit while blocking your opponent.

How It Works

  • Each player has a star and places planets on orbits around their star. Planets advance with their chosen step size along their orbit after each turn.

  • In the placement phase, each side places up to 3 planets and then confirms ready. After that, the main game begins.

  • On your turn you can: place a new planet (choose orbit position, direction, and step count), rotate your galaxy (X, Y, or Z), move your galaxy (translate it in space) or pass.

  • If one of your planets hits the opponent’s star, you win (with an exception: a planet you just placed that would hit the star on the very next check is destroyed instead of counting as a win). If multiple planets collide (regardless of which player they belong to), they are all destroyed.

    Note: Hit detection is applied only when the turn ends and all planet movements are completed.

    • Local multiplayer — Two players on one PC.

    • Single player vs AI — Challenge an AI opponent. (Not too smart... Might improve it in the future.)

    • Online multiplayer (Steam) — Host a game or join a friend via Steam (friends-only lobbies, 2 players).

If you like short, tactical, turn-based games that you can play locally or online with a friend, this game is for you.

Big thanks to 'Deep-Fold' for the pixel art assets. Have fun!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
